sheet.prompt: Character model sheet of the girl on a plain white background: three full-body views side by side at the same scale — front view, three-quarter view facing right, and side profile facing right — standing relaxed, hood down. No text, no labels.
sheet.style: Classic hand-drawn Japanese 2D cel animation from the late 1980s and 1990s: thin, clean, even-weight dark-brown outlines; flat cel colours with exactly ONE darker shadow tone per colour (hard-edged shadow shapes, light from upper left); no gradients, no painterly texture, no 3D shading, no glow. Natural, gentle proportions: the girl is about 7 years old and about 5 heads tall — not chibi, not big-eyed. Simple warm face: small dark eyes with one white highlight, tiny nose line, small mouth, soft pink cheeks. The same girl in every image: short black bob haircut with a straight fringe, orange-red hooded raincoat (#E0692E) reaching mid-thigh with dark-orange shadow, navy trousers, yellow rain boots.
